content: Ankakin Yeisuw ivag kamnat
Yam kweinim katanok ikous, Yeisuw itokes Pita siney asteiy, tasiyas Yemes son bwadan Yon; ikatulags ineis wakunuwatan koy avakaein; asteivas isiwas.
Wamtes ivag ankakin kweitan, magin ikamnat ma̱wana ka̱las mititeilin, anakweim ilapupwa̱kaw singay gimagim.
Mo ikines Moses son Ilaytiy illivans sisiy Yeisuw.
Iw to Pita, idibek Yeisuw, ilana, “Guyaw, singay bwein tasesus towen. Magat sivinam mo bawlul mibwan bunatoun, bunatan yak, bunatan Moses, bunatan Ilaytiy.”
Igaw ilivan, lov kweitan singay kamnat mo imteilis, aygan teitan wanuwan lov ilana, “Mtowen Natug bwanabwein, singay ibwein nanoug waseg; kuliganes aygan.”
Navamul iliganes livan towen, ikalouws kantukovs, singay aspwa̱yat.
Yeisuw gog im ikabkwen wous, ilana, “Kutamanaws. Awoum beivag amipwa̱yat.”
Itamanaws, ikinewas, nag ivag gamag, misinaka Yeisuw.
Igawa iwwloubus, Yeisuw mo idibakes, ilana, “Awoum kwamteles sinap towen nukukines. Kwawumes. Igaw Gimgilitoun yey bakanig, ba̱kit vayuwein, mo kwamteles.”
Navamul ikatiga̱nes, ilansa, “Aveiyag wawun takatimlakeins kaleiwag ilivans, ‘Ilaytiy wanamug beim, Mesay wankuyeim’?”

Iw to Yeisuw, ilana, “Mounid livan towen ‘Ilaytiy beim mo bikatilow youd babaw’; tage bo neim. Tasiyas gog nag iwtusis; tage sivines beiweiys-wan, mo iyagages. Igaw mo biyagageigs yey, Gimgilitoun yey, bo ma̱wan.”
Navamul mo idumwal ninous, peinan ikakins-wan tabibapta̱ysein gamags towen Yon mamagina Ilaytiy.
Gwad takabala̱wein Yeisuw ivag, mo ibwein

Ikous, inounas, inekes gamag babaw, teitan taw im, ikulul wamatan Yeisuw, ilana, “Guyaw, binok nuwam natug, peinan ikabala̱wein, ankatoun avakaein. Tut babaw ikalka̱louw ininein wa̱kov, tut babaw ikalka̱louw ininein wayvagam.
“Awey natug muvamul wasigeis; iyokons bo nag.”
Yeisuw idibakes tasiyas, ilana, “Takakons yakamiy, minamis nag. Bo akawgwes amisinap kakon. Kumey gwad towen.”
Yeisuw idibek yeiluw towen neiweiy gwad, mo ikilev. Gwad towen mo ibwein, tut towen waseg.
Navamul mo inekes Yeisuw anmwa̱net nises, ikatugwans, “na-ikadilokem bakakayeb yeiluw towen?”

Iw to Yeisuw, ilana, “Peinan nag kunmises Yowbad va̱gan bivag. Mounid adibakeimiy, magat minamis mamagina tipol veitun, igaw bukudibek koy towen kulana, ‘Kunoun kun kutoun palatan,’ mo binoun; e, sinap babaw mo bikadilokeimiy.”
Yeisuw ilivnek bikanig, mo beikit vayuwein
Igaw nisesus Galiliy, Yeisuw idibakes, “Teitan bisilkodeig yey, Gimgilitoun yey; gamag mwasanin mo biyousigs, bikatimateigs, yam kweitoun mo ba̱kit vayuwein.” Iliganes, singay ikalin nuwes.
Simoney iba̱nes wanuwan in
Inounas ineis Kapaneyum. Iweis tasiyas takaweins ta̱kis (ta̱kis towen silma̱nin Yowbad nabunatum), ikatugans Pita waseg, ilansa, “Tabta mutovek itam nata̱kis issekem, o nag?”
Pita itam, ilana, “Oo!” Pita iyum in wasibunatum. Iw to Yeisuw, ilana, “Saymon, wananoum yak, takaleiwags ven watinow nitsiyas bipa̱yins wasigeis timsiyas? o tobwag gamag bipa̱yins adok?”

Pita ilana, “Tobwag gamag.” Iw to Yeisuw, ilana, “Mounid. Nitsiyas nag bipa̱yins, nag. Tage bweina bitapa̱yin silma̱nin Yowbad nabunatum; mata ge bigeg ninous tasiyas. Kun kuksikous, in wanamug bukukous, kukin wanuwan mo bukuban idamoney, bo ikadilok idata̱kis aditeiy. Kukow kusekes takaweins ta̱kis tasiyas.”
